messages:
elaine: FYI canary for harbor-lite-q3 (int8) shows a spike in funcall JSON parse errors — ~1.8% vs baseline ~0.2%. seeing trailing commas and occasional extra NDJSON lines.

matt: ouch. can you paste a few raw examples?

elaine: sure — one example: ```{"tool":"lookup","args":{"q":"What's the population of Paris"},}``` trailing comma. another is NDJSON where there's an extra "-meta":... line after the json blob.

sophia: is this in streaming only or hitting non-streaming invokes too?

elaine: mostly streaming. batch has tiny blip (~0.05%). seems correlated with long kv-cache prefixes and short response bodies.

miranda: infra-bot, can you dump the canary summary?

infra-bot: Canary run id: canary-2026-03-22-07 | model: harbor-lite-q3-int8 | sample_size=5000 | parse_failures=89 (1.78%) | baseline_model parse_failures=10 (0.20%). logs: /canary/harbor-lite-q3/2026-03-22-07

devon: plan: 1) reproduce locally with same prompt seeds 2) triage top 100 failure samples 3) try incremental rescue heuristics (ndjson split, tolerant JSON5 parser, trailing-comma fix) behind canary flag 4) run 50k replay to measure delta.

matt: quick idea: implement NDJSON-split fallback that only triggers on parse fail, then attempt a json5 parse and finally small regex close-brace heuristics. log which fallback used.

sophia: caution: don't mutate outputs for downstream evals. we should have a rescue-only path that annotates the response and preserves original in logs. that keeps signal for golden evals.

elaine: proposal: add an "introspective parse pass" in the canary router: on parse_fail -> try (a) ndjson split (b) json5 tolerant parse (c) close-brace regex that trims trailing garbage and appends missing braces -> set rescue_applied=true and rescue.type=(ndjson|json5|regex). Collect metrics rescue.success_rate and rescue.noise_rate. If rescue consistently reduces visible regressions, promote to Optimize suggestion.

miranda: can we add metric tags: rescue.applied=true/false, rescue.type=ndjson|regex|json5, rescue.latency_ms, rescue.original_response_id? helps slice by route.

devon: I'll draft the PR and add a guarded flag so this only runs in canary. will also add sample-diff logging to /canary/parses and a small unit test set (trailing comma, duplicated sentinel, ndjson extra-line). assigning to myself.

matt: ping me on the PR for a quick review. please include a replay harness job: 50k samples, and a golden-eval comparison for funcall acceptance rate and semantic quality.

elaine: PR opened: https://git.redwood/internal/pulls/4521 — patch adds introspective parse pass behind flag, metric tags, and a debug log sink. kicking off 50k replay now. will post results. :rocket:

sophia: also add an eval case for kv-cache prefix influence — sounds correlated. and add a small canary throttle: rescue_ratio default 0.1 so we don't over-correct signals during initial test.

elaine: good call. if rescue looks spurious we will reduce rescue_ratio and raise an alert. thanks all — will update with replay results and golden eval diffs.
